journey.name: independent public and private sharing
journey.description: Use an unfunded test wallet with a signed-in, locally created Pubky profile and private contact payments enabled through onboarding. Public payments must not have been enabled. Keep the network available, resolve any unrelated USDT introduction first, and do not receive payments during this journey. Remote endpoint contents, controlled network failures and backup restoration require the manual checks in this suite's README.

actions.action: Open Receive, select Savings and record the Bitcoin address
Scroll to the payment sharing settings
Verify Private contact payments (identifier "PrivateContactPaymentsToggle") is on and Public payments (identifier "PublicPaymentsToggle") is off
Verify the public sharing warning says payment details will be public and linked to the profile
Turn Public payments on and wait for the operation to finish
Verify both sharing switches are on
Turn Private contact payments off and wait for the operation to finish
Verify Private contact payments is off and Public payments remains on
Turn Public payments off and wait for the operation to finish
Verify both sharing switches are off
Turn Private contact payments on and wait for the operation to finish
Verify Private contact payments is on and Public payments remains off
Close and reopen Bitkit without clearing app data, then reopen Settings General
Scroll to the payment sharing settings
Verify Private contact payments is still on and Public payments is still off
Open Receive, select Savings and verify the Bitcoin address is unchanged from the recorded address
